Install cuplyr from source

Source: R/install.R
install_cuplyr.Rd

Installs cuplyr by setting up build dependencies (if needed) and running ./configure && R CMD INSTALL .. Supports multiple methods for providing CUDA/cuDF dependencies.

Usage

install_cuplyr(
  method = c("auto", "pixi", "conda", "system"),
  repo = NULL,
  ref = "main",
  conda_prefix = NULL,
  configure_args = character(),
  dry_run = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

method

How to obtain build dependencies:

"auto"

Try methods in order: pixi, conda, system

"pixi"

Use pixi to manage a reproducible environment

"conda"

Use conda/mamba to install RAPIDS into a prefix

"system"

Assume CUDA and cuDF are already installed on the system

repo

GitHub repository URL or local path to cuplyr source. If NULL, assumes current directory is the cuplyr source tree.

ref

Git branch or tag to install. Only used when repo is a URL.

conda_prefix

Path for the conda environment when method = "conda". Defaults to the active conda environment (unless it is base), then "/opt/rapids" on Colab and cloud GPUs, then ~/.local/share/cuplyr/rapids (or under XDG_DATA_HOME). An existing environment is added to, never replaced.

configure_args

Extra arguments passed to ./configure.

dry_run

If TRUE, print what would be done without executing.

verbose

If TRUE, print detailed progress.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE on success.

Details

Method details

auto (default): Tries methods in order of preference:

  1. If pixi is on PATH and the source tree has pixi.toml, use pixi

  2. If mamba or conda is on PATH, use conda

  3. If CUDA and cuDF are already available, use system

pixi: Runs pixi run install which handles everything. Requires pixi to be installed.

conda: Installs RAPIDS 26.10 for CUDA 13, with the CUDA compiler and headers, into a conda environment, then configures and builds cuplyr against it. Requires mamba or conda.

system: Assumes CUDA_HOME and CONDA_PREFIX/CUDF_HOME are already set. Runs ./configure && R CMD INSTALL . directly.

Pre-flight

Before building, install_cuplyr() runs check_deps() and reports any missing dependencies. With method = "conda", missing RAPIDS packages are installed automatically.

See also

check_deps() for dependency checking, verify_installation() for post-install verification, diagnostics() for troubleshooting

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Auto-detect best method
install_cuplyr()

# Use conda explicitly
install_cuplyr(method = "conda")

# System install (CUDA/cuDF already available)
install_cuplyr(method = "system")

# Preview what would happen
install_cuplyr(dry_run = TRUE)

# Install from GitHub
install_cuplyr(repo = "https://github.com/bbtheo/cuplyr.git")
} # }
